column4: cleat#2432/#2865: four standalone top-level tests (no t.Run subtests, unlike the sibling catalogdiff-dialect-tests.tsv/the-mssql-snapshot-sees-the-attributes-it-selects.tsv lines in this same job), each proving one new MSSQL-only comparator (security policies, triggers, schemas, roles). This job runs ./migration/... with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set, so all four skip without CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES=<pg> go test ./migration/catalogdiff/... -run 'TestTheMSSQLSnapshotSees(SecurityPolicies|Triggers|Schemas|Roles)' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these four, 0 failures.

Same four tests, same shape, this job's own dialect: this job runs the full unfiltered ./engine/... ./migration/... sweep with ONLY CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL set, so MSSQL is absent here too and all four skip. Per-test lines rather than folding into #2863's multi-db-ci-initial-measurement.tsv named alternation on purpose -- that line is measured against a specific run and ordering with #2863 (which could land before or after this PR) must not change what either PR needs to write. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL set: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL=<my> go test ./migration/catalogdiff/... -run 'TestTheMSSQLSnapshotSees(SecurityPolicies|Triggers|Schemas|Roles)' -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly these four, 0 failures.
